config.label: Folders the tools may read data files from and write reports to (separated by : on macOS/Linux, ; on Windows)
config.description: Folders the tools may read data files from and write reports to (separated by : on macOS/Linux, ; on Windows). Defaults to the client's workspace roots, or the current directory.

config.label: CSV/TSV/Parquet files above this size (MB) are streamed in parallel passes; any size works
config.description: CSV/TSV/Parquet files above this size (MB) are streamed in parallel passes; any size works. Default 512.

config.label: Parallel readers for large files
config.description: Parallel readers for large files. Default: all CPU cores but one (max 16).

config.label: Keep columns read from large files for fast follow-up questions: ask (default), on or off
config.description: Keep columns read from large files for fast follow-up questions: ask (default), on or off.

config.label: Folder for saved large-file columns
config.description: Folder for saved large-file columns. Default: the system temp folder.

config.label: Refuse data files larger than this (MB)
config.description: Refuse data files larger than this (MB). Default: no limit.

config.label: on (default): classify each request and follow the six-step workflow for hypothesis tests
config.description: on (default): classify each request and follow the six-step workflow for hypothesis tests. off: expose the individual test tools directly.

config.label: on (default): the user confirms every column, chart type and report section before anything runs
config.description: on (default): the user confirms every column, chart type and report section before anything runs. off: run with the AI's choices.

config.label: auto (default): forms where the client supports them
config.description: auto (default): forms where the client supports them. chat: always ask in the conversation (recommended for Claude Code).

config.label: Set to 1 to remove the one-line Stats Explorer app link from results
config.description: Set to 1 to remove the one-line Stats Explorer app link from results.

config.label: Independent checks by Jev (TypeSafe): off (default), cooperate (the AI calls your Jev MCP server), enforce (Stats Explorer calls the Jev API) or orchestrated (signed decisions from an orchestrator)
config.description: Independent checks by Jev (TypeSafe): off (default), cooperate (the AI calls your Jev MCP server), enforce (Stats Explorer calls the Jev API) or orchestrated (signed decisions from an orchestrator).

config.label: Comma list of plan, conclusions, data
config.description: Comma list of plan, conclusions, data. Default plan,conclusions (data sends column names and text samples to Jev).

config.label: Enforce mode only: TypeSafe API key Stats Explorer uses to call Jev
config.description: Enforce mode only: TypeSafe API key Stats Explorer uses to call Jev.

config.label: Orchestrated mode only: shared secret (32+ characters) the orchestrator signs decisions with
config.description: Orchestrated mode only: shared secret (32+ characters) the orchestrator signs decisions with.

config.label: Path of a JSON Lines file recording every Jev checkpoint decision
config.description: Path of a JSON Lines file recording every Jev checkpoint decision.
